categories.title: Serums
categories.tagline: Concentrated care for what your skin needs right now.
categories.intro: A serum is the most targeted step of a routine: a lightweight formula with a high concentration of one or two key ingredients, made to absorb fast and work under your moisturizer. Pick it by what you want to see change.

benefits.title: Targeted
benefits.text: Each serum focuses on one goal — shine, dark spots, hydration, fine lines or redness.

benefits.title: Lightweight
benefits.text: Water-light textures that absorb in seconds and layer under any cream or sunscreen.

benefits.title: Concentrated
benefits.text: Higher levels of active ingredients than a moisturizer, so a few drops go a long way.

howTo.title: Start clean
howTo.text: Apply after cleansing and toning, on skin that is dry or slightly damp.

howTo.title: 2–3 drops
howTo.text: Release a few drops into your palm or onto your fingertips — more product doesn't mean better results.

howTo.title: Press, don't rub
howTo.text: Gently press over face and neck and let it absorb for 30 seconds.

howTo.title: Seal it in
howTo.text: Follow with moisturizer, and with sunscreen in the morning.

categories.tip: Using more than one? Vitamin C in the morning, retinal at night, and hyaluronic or centella any time.

captions.say: Two or three drops into your palm.
Press gently over face and neck. Don't rub.
Then seal it in with your moisturizer.

categories.title: Cleansers
categories.tagline: Every good routine starts with clean skin.
categories.intro: Cleansing removes sunscreen, makeup, oil and the day's pollution so everything you apply next can actually reach your skin. The right cleanser leaves skin fresh and comfortable — never tight.

benefits.title: A clean base
benefits.text: Removes what sits on the surface so serums and creams absorb better.

benefits.title: Balanced
benefits.text: pH-balanced formulas that respect your skin barrier.

benefits.title: For your skin type
benefits.text: A cream for dry or sensitive skin, a gel with salicylic acid for oily skin.

howTo.title: Wet your face
howTo.text: Use lukewarm water — hot water can dry the skin.

howTo.title: A pea-sized amount
howTo.text: Massage gently for 30–60 seconds, including the hairline and jaw.

howTo.title: Rinse and pat dry
howTo.text: Rinse well and pat, don't rub, with a soft towel.

howTo.title: Morning and night
howTo.text: At night, cleanse twice if you wore sunscreen or makeup.

categories.tip: If your skin feels tight after cleansing, your cleanser is too strong.

categories.title: Toners & Exfoliants
categories.tagline: Rebalance every day, smooth a few nights a week.
categories.intro: A toner rehydrates and preps skin in seconds after cleansing. An exfoliant gently dissolves the dull surface layer so skin looks smoother and more even. Use the toner daily and the exfoliant two or three evenings a week.

benefits.title: Prepped skin
benefits.text: A light layer of hydration that helps the next steps spread and absorb.

benefits.title: Smoother texture
benefits.text: Gentle acids lift dullness and roughness without scrubbing.

benefits.title: More even tone
benefits.text: Regular, gentle exfoliation helps skin look brighter over time.

howTo.title: After cleansing
howTo.text: Pat the toner in with your hands or a cotton pad.

howTo.title: Exfoliate at night
howTo.text: Apply a thin layer of exfoliant to dry skin, 2–3 nights a week.

howTo.title: Don't mix strong actives
howTo.text: Skip retinal on the nights you exfoliate.

howTo.title: Sunscreen next day
howTo.text: Acids make skin more sun-sensitive — SPF every morning.

categories.tip: Start exfoliating twice a week and only increase if your skin feels comfortable.

categories.title: Moisturizers
categories.tagline: Lock in hydration and support your skin barrier.
categories.intro: A moisturizer seals in everything you applied before and keeps water in your skin for hours. Even oily skin needs one — the difference is the texture: a light gel-cream or a rich, cushioning cream.

benefits.title: Lasting hydration
benefits.text: Keeps skin comfortable and supple all day or all night.

benefits.title: Barrier support
benefits.text: Ceramides and humectants help the skin hold on to moisture.

benefits.title: Seals your routine
benefits.text: Locks serums in so they keep working.

howTo.title: Last step at night
howTo.text: Apply after your serum, as the final step of the evening.

howTo.title: Before SPF in the morning
howTo.text: Let it settle for a minute before sunscreen.

howTo.title: Warm and press
howTo.text: Warm a small amount between your fingers and press it in.

howTo.title: Don't forget the neck
howTo.text: Extend down the neck and décolletage.

categories.tip: Skin feels tight by midday? Move to a richer texture.

categories.title: Sun Protection
categories.tagline: The step that protects all the others.
categories.intro: Daily sunscreen is the most effective way to keep skin looking even and youthful. Use it every morning as the last step of your routine — cloudy days and indoors near windows included.

benefits.title: Protects your results
benefits.text: Helps prevent new dark spots while your serums work.

benefits.title: Every skin tone
benefits.text: A sheer fluid with no white cast.

howTo.title: Last step, every morning
howTo.text: Apply after your moisturizer has settled.

howTo.title: Use enough
howTo.text: About two finger-lengths for face and neck.

howTo.title: 15 minutes before sun
howTo.text: Give it time to form an even film.

howTo.title: Reapply
howTo.text: Every 2 hours outdoors, and after swimming or sweating.

chooser.need: Daily protection for every skin type

categories.tip: Sunscreen is one part of sun protection: shade and a hat help too.

categories.title: Masks
categories.tagline: Fifteen minutes to calm, hydrate and unwind.
categories.intro: A sheet mask is an intensive boost of hydration and a moment to slow down. Use it two or three evenings a week, after toning and before moisturizer.

benefits.title: Deep hydration
benefits.text: A biocellulose sheet holds more essence against the skin.

benefits.title: Calming
benefits.text: Chamomile and centella help skin look calmer after a long day.

benefits.title: A ritual
benefits.text: Fifteen quiet minutes that make the routine something to look forward to.

howTo.title: Cleanse and tone
howTo.text: Start with clean, slightly damp skin.

howTo.title: Unfold and smooth
howTo.text: Place the mask and smooth out any air bubbles.

howTo.title: Relax 15–20 minutes
howTo.text: Don't leave it on until it dries.

howTo.title: Pat in and moisturize
howTo.text: Press the leftover essence into the skin, then seal with cream.

categories.tip: Keep a mask in the fridge for an extra-cooling effect.
